summary: Every undo and restore is now fully recorded, and repeating analyzer problems no longer flood support.

fixes.title: Undo and restore are always recorded
fixes.text: Undoing a tagging run and restoring a tampered tag now record each change before making it, then its outcome. No change is ever made without a record.

fixes.title: Analyzer gaps are counted and reported once
fixes.text: When the CA Policy Analyzer cannot evaluate some users, the run says how many. If that repeats, Invardia support gets one item instead of one per run.

fixes.title: Partial analyzer runs are labelled reliably
fixes.text: Whether a CA Policy Analyzer run was partial because of its sign-in limit is now recorded directly, so it is always shown correctly.
